CLAS 2026

CLAS 2026 will take place on Thursday, April 30 from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. As per faculty vote, classes are canceled on Thursday in order to allow the whole Colby community participate in the celebration of student scholarship. Those Thursday classes will occur on Friday, May 1. (Friday classes this week are canceled.) 

About

The Colby Liberal Arts Symposium (CLAS) is a celebration of student scholarship. CLAS 2025 features the work of over 678 separate Colby students, who will present 498 separate projects. CLAS is the largest undergraduate research symposium of any liberal arts college in the country. 

CLAS was created (by faculty vote) in 2014 to extend the positive impact of its predecessor—the Colby Undergraduate Research Symposium (CURS). Following an extended pandemic pause (2020-22), CLAS relaunched in 2023 as one of Colby’s beloved annual traditions.

On Thursday, classes are canceled so faculty, staff, and students can attend CLAS. In addition to student posters and presentations, the day features a set of wild-card sessions with interdisciplinary topics and creative formats, the Phi Beta Kappa speech contest at noon, and a culminating event of PowerPoint Karaoke in which four Colby faculty members compete to deliver PowerPoint decks that they have never seen; their improvisational skills will be on full display.

As an extension of CLAS, the final two weeks of the term also include Open CLAS sessions during regular class times. Students will make classroom presentations that are open to the public.
